title: Microsoft Purview DLP: aggregate alerts by user (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
notes: claim 54: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft publishes no automation for tenant-level user-based aggregation overlooks parameters in the Set-PolicyConfig reference. The roadmap facts and the preview behaviour are supported, but the Defender investigation guidance needs qualifications and the assertion that end users do not see alerts is not established.

claims.where: controls[0].ui/api; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Neither an admin UI route nor a command or API for tenant-level user-based aggregation and its time window is documented.
claims.quote: Set-PolicyConfig ... [-AggregationTimeWindowForDlpAlerts <System.UInt32>] ... [-IsUserBaseDlpAlertAggregationEnabled <Boolean>]
claims.fix: Remove the both-null control row rather than claiming that no automation is published. Replace the blanket command absence in Governance controls with: 'The Security & Compliance PowerShell Set-PolicyConfig reference lists -IsUserBaseDlpAlertAggregationEnabled (Boolean) and -AggregationTimeWindowForDlpAlerts (System.UInt32), but their descriptions are placeholders, so their detailed behaviour and cloud applicability are not stated there.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/set-policyconfig. Replace the automation part of the open question with 'How do the published Set-PolicyConfig aggregation parameters behave in these clouds?' Do not infer the time parameter's units or allowed values from its name.
